rules.video: subset == 'train' -> train, subset == 'val_seen' -> val; mp4 on HF (tar_index.csv of htstep-videos, htstep-val-seen-videos part1/part2; val prefers htstep-val-seen-videos); YouCook2 ids excluded (yc2_overlap); mp4 unreadable at precut -> excluded
rules.step: keep Full Match and Partial Match; segment[1] > segment[0]; first 48 in json order; step_idx = position after that filter
rules.text: f'{activity}: {headline.strip()}' from the taxonomy row with global_step_index == id
rules.window: from the mp4 (decord frames / avg fps): end > length -> clamped; start >= length -> step dropped (past_end)
